- Native·Bun·Electron·build·UI 실행, 위임, docs·ledger 저장, 자체 승인은 하지 않았습니다.

검증 명령의 경로를 배열로 정리했습니다. 저장소 root에서 실행합니다.

```bash
src=apps/desktop-app/src
owned=(
  "$src/renderer/entities/workbench/model/store.ts"
  "$src/renderer/entities/workbench/model/controller.ts"
  "$src/renderer/entities/workbench/index.ts"
  "$src/renderer/shared/api/index.ts"
  "$src/renderer/features/configuration-drafts/index.tsx"
  "$src/renderer/features/configuration-drafts/drafts.module.css"
  "$src/renderer/features/configuration-drafts/agent-files.tsx"
  "$src/workbench-store.test.mjs"
)
lint_owned=("${owned[@]:0:5}" "${owned[@]:6:2}")
config_tests=(
  "$src/configuration-agent.test.mjs"
  "$src/configuration-agent-runtime-api.test.mjs"
  "$src/configuration-draft.test.mjs"
  "$src/configuration-skill-draft.test.mjs"
  "$src/configuration-skill-runtime-api.test.mjs"
  "$src/configuration-skill-runtime.test.mjs"
)

set -o pipefail
node --import tsx --test --test-reporter=tap \
  "$src/workbench-store.test.mjs" "${config_tests[@]}" | tail -n 10
pnpm exec tsc -p apps/desktop-app/tsconfig.json --noEmit
pnpm exec eslint --config apps/desktop-app/eslint.config.mjs "${lint_owned[@]}"
pnpm exec prettier --check "${owned[@]}"
node apps/desktop-app/scripts/check-renderer-boundaries.mjs
```
